purpose: New recordings from the existing Lake Hood public camera; not a new location or replacement of failures
reference_scope: Full UTC day, production archive, original broad region; no clock or selected-aircraft filtering

ground_truth.basis: Previously verified owner map pin; not a survey

acceptance: First candidate within 250 m and unambiguous. Preserve all failures and data/capture errors. Verify the source date separately; do not supply the recording clock, camera coordinates or aircraft identities to the app.
execution: Use the fixed experimental executable after the current full Lake experiment finishes; do not replace its binary or tune parameters from fresh results.
